title: Frozen regression comparison runner
scope: One synthetic Python T1 comparison: saved-note-preview-after-edit
source: The bootstrap-bound original T1 snapshot and manifest under the private run artifact
correctedOutput: A complete frozen T1 output snapshot and exact SHA256 manifest

case.expectedBaselineAssertion: Initial note A != Saved note A

comparison: The baseline disposable copy retains the original business source and receives only the selected regression test from the frozen output.
The corrected disposable copy receives the corrected business source and the same selected regression test bytes.
The selected named test runs on both sides. The full original guard suite runs on both sides; the two original guard methods must remain byte-for-byte equivalent at the Python AST level.

A verified comparison requires subprocess exit 1 plus the baseline failure only at the named assertion with the frozen stale and expected values, and subprocess exit 0 plus corrected named-test and full-suite success with the expected test count. Transcript text without the required exit code is insufficient. Import failures, setup failures, timeouts, zero tests, other assertions, or source changes are insufficient.
inputValidation: Both manifests must enumerate the complete snapshot file set and match every SHA256.
The only output changes allowed are src/workspace.py and tests/test_workspace.py.
Symlinks, special files, path traversal, extra files, changed original guard tests, missing regression, stale result directories, and input mutation are rejected or reported insufficient.
limits: Trusted authorized synthetic Python code only. This runner is not an OS sandbox, generic framework, or product verifier.
